dependencies.name: ECMAScript Internationalization API (ECMA-402)
dependencies.pattern: Use native Intl APIs with explicit locale for dates, times, numbers and plural selection; keep stored timestamps UTC and avoid adding a runtime library without a demonstrated gap.

dependencies.version: Current official documentation consulted 2026-10-06; no dependency selected
dependencies.pattern: Namespaced JSON catalogs support modular translation files; interpolation escaping must remain enabled when HTML rendering is used. Architect review recommends a lightweight shared ESM helper and native Intl instead of adopting i18next in this no-bundler vanilla frontend/scripts architecture.

dependencies.name: Existing product architecture and locale surfaces

existing.currentVersion: JavaScript ESM; Fastify/static vanilla web; Prisma 6.19.3; PostgreSQL 18.6; host .sh/.bat lifecycle tools; OBS Browser Source

dependencies.pattern: Keep stable machine identifiers separate from display copy; select a catalog representation that Node, browser and host tools can consume, and define offline fallback behavior explicitly.

researchFindings: The product has no frontend bundler; any runtime translation dependency must prove compatibility with static browser ESM, Node ESM, and host tools without compilation.
The owner confirmed one catalog per module and locale, roots !fila/!queue/!cola with no cross-locale aliases, and one editable installation locale.

Repository inspection found shell and batch lifecycle tools plus Compose volumes. Architecture review selected PostgreSQL as the authority and .local/product-locale.state as a recoverable revisioned projection; recovery is not yet test-proven.
The owner approved preserving streamer-authored queue/reward/widget text exactly as entered and localizing only product-owned text. Persisted values must never be silently overwritten.
unverifiedClaims: The initial Node parser contract passes 9/9; cross-runtime browser/Node/shell/PowerShell parsing, strict UTF-8 byte decoding, placeholder allowlists, and catalog parity are not yet verified.
The host locale projection remains design-only; crash recovery, atomicity, permissions, Compose persistence, and stale/offline reads still need tests.
The owner-approved reserved-root collision policy has no implementation or upgrade/migration test yet.
Catalog validator, locale migration, installer language selection, and localized command parsing are not implemented or validated.
recommendations: Keep one canonical locale in PostgreSQL and initialize only when absent; project a monotonic revision to an atomically replaced local host file and recover the projection on startup/retry.
Use UTF-8 no-BOM TSV files split by module and locale, with literal text, allowlisted placeholders, local/CI validation, and pt-BR fallback; no external translation service.
Before localizing host tools, test crash between commit/projection, write failure, corruption, stale/offline state, recovery, and permissions.
Make catalog validation a CI gate for schema, required keys, placeholders, plurals, locale IDs, and safe content.
Continue test-first implementation of owner-approved policies and request independent QA follow-up after current spec/editorial consistency findings are closed.
